under.title: XOS accounts are for people 18 and older
under.sentence: You told us you are under 18, so you cannot use Compass with this sign-in. If you continue, we close it.
under.keeps: We also delete your profile and its files, your badge photos, your settings, what you sent our support team, and the answers and personal agreements you gave XOS. Any organization you worked with keeps the records the law requires, such as hours you worked, and a note with your email address that your account was deleted, and XOS keeps a record of that deletion with your account IDs but no name. XOS also keeps a monthly count of people under 18 it turned away, which does not identify you. Deleted data stays in backups until they expire.

aiDisclosure.title: Allow AI features in Compass?
aiDisclosure.provider: AI features send data to a third-party AI provider. Today that provider is Anthropic, which runs the Claude models for us.
aiDisclosure.sent: What goes to it: the questions you ask the assistant, with the matching SOPs, handbook pages and records you can already see, and the receipt photos you take for an expense when your organization has receipt reading on.
aiDisclosure.notSent: Medical records and Restricted fields, such as pay rates, bank details and government IDs, are not sent. Anything visible in a photo you take is. The provider does not train its models on this data.
aiDisclosure.change: Compass sends nothing of yours to the provider until you allow it. If you do not, AI features stay off for you everywhere in XOS and Compass works without them. You can change this in Settings.
aiDisclosure.others: This choice covers the AI features you use yourself. Until you choose, AI features you use in the XOS web apps follow your organization's setting. If your organization has AI features on, other people in it can still use them on records they can see, including records about you.
aiDisclosure.failed: We could not save your choice, so nothing changed and nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.
aiDisclosure.declined: AI features are off, as you chose. To use them, allow them below.
aiDisclosure.settingsHelp: Sends your questions and receipt photos to a third-party AI provider. Turning this off turns AI features off for you everywhere in XOS. It does not stop other people in your organization using them on records they can see.
